Owner-authorized 2026-10-25 as its own task (step 2 of the S3d plan). Integrate the Codex line onto local main: codex/connected-assessment-20261023 (tip 629c811ab) plus claude/evidence-binding-s0 and claude/evidence-binding-s1 (tip d02c58df8). It diverged from main at 13aec7cc8: 99 commits, 833 files, including Scala changes in align, pipeline, codec, embed-bench and embed-onnx, edits to ADRs 0009, 0019 and 0022, about 250 files under docs/refactor, and 126 committed .mote/authority files (forbidden: remove from the integration; ops replicate, authority does not). git merge-tree against main reports no textual conflict; a conflict-free merge is not a working merge.
Owner actor codex-connected-assessment-20261023 last acted 2026-10-23 11:51Z (gone per tools/who-is-live.sh). S0 (bd-01M5MR1YSPFVGD8G6BGJ39DR3Y) and S1 (bd-01M5MR2N8NN2XZRH6FBWBC1EYT) are approved in review on that stack.
Acceptance: reviewed merge onto main with .mote/authority stripped; T3 gate on the merged tree over the union reference scope, every platform, with totals; storyatlas4s sibling seam check; tools unittest discover with totals; landing recorded on S0, S1 and this bead. Unblocks the S3d assessor change.
